content.text:
This confirms the mismatch: at commit `dd99776` (initial commit), main and test packages both matched (`com.github.piotr.rusin.yule`). At commit `12c5454`, the main source package was renamed to `com.github.piotr_rusin.yule` (directory `piotr` → `piotr_rusin`), but the test file was left behind at the old `com.github.piotr.rusin.yule` package/directory. This mismatch is exactly what `fdab258` (the bug-fix) corrects by renaming the test file's package/directory to `piotr_rusin` to match.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 12c5454891bd93c933f7d6c0fee46c30506bf01f

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the history of `YuleApplicationTests.java` with `git log --follow`, which showed only two prior commits touching this file: `dd99776` (initial project scaffold) and `12c5454`. I then diffed both commits and compared the full source tree layout at each point using `git ls-tree`.

**(2) The introduced bug:** In `dd99776`, both the main application code and the test lived under `com.github.piotr.rusin.yule` — packages matched. In `12c5454`, the author renamed the main-source package from `com.github.piotr.rusin.yule` to `com.github.piotr_rusin.yule` (moving `YuleApplication.java` and adding `entity/Post.java` under the new `piotr_rusin` directory), but did **not** apply the same rename to the test file — `YuleApplicationTests.java` was left in `src/test/java/com/github/piotr/rusin/yule/` with `package com.github.piotr.rusin.yule;`.

**(3) Supporting evidence:** The test class uses `@SpringBootTest` with no explicit `classes` attribute, meaning Spring Boot's test runner auto-detects the `@SpringBootApplication`-annotated configuration class by searching the test class's package and its parent packages. After `12c5454`, the test resides in package `com.github.piotr.rusin.yule` while the actual `@SpringBootApplication` class moved to the sibling-but-different package tree `com.github.piotr_rusin.yule`. These are not parent/child packages (`piotr` vs `piotr_rusin` are different package segments), so Spring Boot can no longer locate the configuration, and the `contextLoads()` test would fail at runtime with an `IllegalStateException`/context-loading failure. The fix commit `fdab258` directly repairs this by renaming the test's package and directory from `piotr/rusin` to `piotr_rusin`, restoring the match with the main source tree — confirming `12c5454` as the point the mismatch (and thus the bug) was introduced.

I'm fairly confident in this identification since the diff evidence is direct (matching packages before, divergent after, and the fix simply re-aligning them), though I did not build/run the project to empirically reproduce the Spring context failure.
